feed.title: ENTITY Project Updates
feed.subtitle: Release, qualification, developer and operator updates for ENTITY by Blackmore Technology Group Limited.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.3 — current supported remediation release
entry.summary: ENTITY v3.4.3 is the current supported runtime. The bounded remediation records 76/76 PASS for the Issue #28 remediation module and 279/279 PASS for the full source suite. BTDU remains component version 3.4.2 unchanged; v3.4.2 remains immutable historical evidence.

entry.title: Evaluate ENTITY for your organization — new operator and adopter path
entry.summary: A plain-language evaluation path is available for enterprise architects, security teams, data and AI governance teams, identity architects, research-data infrastructure teams and operators assessing authority, provenance, rights, evidence, recovery and provider portability.

entry.title: Six frozen ENTITY v3.4.2 reproduction tasks open for language-native contributors
entry.summary: Small reproducibility tasks remain open in Rust, TypeScript, C#/.NET, Go, Swift and Java against the exact frozen v3.4.2 26-vector baseline. Each task provides a native run command and exact expected result. These historical target labels do not mean v3.4.2 remains the current runtime.

entry.title: ENTITY standards and interoperability pre-submission working draft
entry.summary: Open technical material for review of provider-neutral authority, provenance, rights, portable state and conformance boundaries. The material is pre-submission and carries no IETF, W3C, DIF or other standards-body endorsement.

entry.title: External v3.4.2 economic counterexample accepted for follow-up qualification
entry.summary: An outside reviewer identified a source-level evidence-substitution replay counterexample against the then-current v3.4.2 derivative-revenue behavior. BTG reproduced the boundary and v3.4.3 subsequently shipped the bounded remediation while preserving the immutable v3.4.2 evidence trail.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.2 — Canonical BTDU Release
entry.summary: ENTITY v3.4.2 introduced the BTDU release line and remains immutable historical evidence. It is superseded for current deployment by ENTITY v3.4.3; the BTDU component itself remains version 3.4.2 unchanged.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.2 Frozen External Qualification Program
entry.summary: Historical frozen-v3.4.2 qualification calls cover hardware-backed key custody, physical multi-host operation, certified-device testing, independent security audit and independent assessor review. The exact frozen target remains unchanged even though v3.4.3 is now the current runtime.

entry.title: External Verification Challenge — reproduce it, break it, or implement one part independently
entry.summary: The current umbrella challenge now identifies ENTITY v3.4.3 as the supported runtime while preserving exact frozen v3.4.2 campaigns as historical test targets where appropriate.

entry.title: AI Governance and Provenance Guide
entry.summary: A technical guide to explicit delegated authority, data/model lineage, evidence boundaries, training/derivation rights and independent scrutiny for governed AI systems.

entry.title: ENTITY Technical Guides
entry.summary: Problem-focused guides for data provenance, sovereign data rights, BTDU versus knowledge graphs/vector indexes, portable digital authority/recovery, and AI governance/provenance.
